summary: Warps Input 1 by sampling it with UV or UVW coordinates read from channels of Input 2.

key_params.name: resolutionsource
key_params.note: Input whose width/height define output resolution.

key_params.name: depthressource
key_params.note: Input whose depth defines output depth for 3D/array textures.

key_params.name: horzsource
key_params.note: Input 2 channel used for horizontal lookup.

key_params.name: vertsource
key_params.note: Input 2 channel used for vertical lookup.

key_params.name: zsource
key_params.note: Input 2 channel used for depth lookup.

key_params.name: extend
key_params.note: Sampling behavior outside the 0-1 coordinate range.

common_gotchas: Input 2 should usually be 16-bit-per-channel or 32-bit float; 8-bit UV maps produce jagged warps.
UV channels are normalized 0-1; out-of-range values are controlled by Extend.
The second input is an absolute lookup image, not a pixel displacement map.
Z lookup only matters when working with 3D textures or 2D texture arrays.
Official docs compare Remap TOP with Displace TOP; choose based on lookup-versus-displacement semantics.
key_concepts: Warps Input 1 by sampling it with UV or UVW coordinates from Input 2.
Input 2 channels map to horizontal, vertical, and depth lookup coordinates.
Lookup values are normalized 0-1 coordinates, not pixel displacements.
Supports 3D textures and 2D texture arrays when Z and depth sources are configured.
